data.one_liner: Line Awesome Icons pack providing 1542 additional icons for Flutter apps
data.what_it_does: Provides the Line Awesome icon set as a Flutter package. Exposes static IconData fields via the LineAwesomeIcons class for use with standard Flutter Icon widgets.
use_when: You want to use Line Awesome icons in your Flutter application
You need an alternative or complementary icon set to Material Icons
avoid_when: You only require the default Material icons
You want a different icon library like FontAwesome
strengths: Easy integration with standard Flutter Icon widgets
Supports all major platforms (Android, iOS, Web, Windows, macOS, Linux)
weaknesses: Increases app asset/font size by bundling a large icon font
No documentation on specific icon names beyond standard usage
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency to pubspec.yaml and import the package.

alternatives.name: font_awesome_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer Font Awesome icons over Line Awesome icons.

alternatives.name: lucide_icons_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer Lucide icons over Line Awesome icons.

alternatives.name: material_symbols_icons
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want Google's Material Symbols instead.
